channel.title: Wire — Programming
channel.description: Programming from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Stop Hardcoding Your Timeouts
item.description: Hardcoded timeouts with no config options are a silent tax on developers outside the wealthy west. A rant about npx skills, Docker Gordon, and the arrogance of assuming everyone has a fast connection. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen
item.description: We find that frontier LLMs are surprisingly good at natively reading and writing neural network weights, well past what we’d expect from humans or conventional algorithms. (1 source: hackernews)

Show HN: Warsaw in voxels – An interactive 3D map of the city centre
item.description: Central Warsaw in 1 m voxels, built from OpenStreetMap, LiDAR and the city's tree database. Walk around the Palace of Culture, change the date, hour and weather, or possess a pedestrian. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Virtual Art Museum built with Three js
item.description: My wife wanted a website for her artworks. While building the website, I suddenly had this urge to try building a virtual art museum to give her motivation. It turned out not bad. Put the rain mode on if you like cats btw. (1 source: lobsters)
